title: Resultar Check tsconfig schema
description: Schema extension for configuring native resultar-check diagnostics in tsconfig.json.

ignoreFilePatterns.description: Glob-style file patterns that Resultar diagnostics should ignore. Bare patterns such as *.test.ts match file basenames; slash patterns such as tests/** match normalized path suffixes.

failOn.description: Minimum Resultar diagnostic severity that makes the CLI exit with status 1. Use off to report without failing CI.

diagnosticSeverity.description: Set severities by stable diagnostic rule id. Names may use camelCase, kebab-case, or resultar/<rule>.

overrides.description: Apply diagnosticSeverity to files matching include globs. Later matching overrides win.

noAwaitInSafeTry.description: Disallow await expressions inside safeTry bodies; use yield* for Resultar values.

noDiscard.description: Require Result and ResultAsync values to be handled or explicitly discarded.

noPromiseInResultSuccess.description: Disallow Promise values in synchronous Result success channels; use asyncMap or ResultAsync.

noDiscardMode.description: Controls no-discard analysis. must-use tracks assigned Resultar values until consumed; direct only reports discarded expressions.

noTaggedErrorConstructorOverride.description: Keep the generated tagged-error constructor intact.

noThrow.description: Disallow throw statements so expected failures stay in Resultar error channels.

noTryCatch.description: Disallow try/catch blocks so expected failures use typed Resultar boundaries. Try/finally without catch remains allowed.

noTryCatchInSafeTry.description: Avoid raw try/catch inside safeTry generators.

noUnsafeAwait.description: Require raw Promise awaits in Resultar async contexts to use Resultar boundaries.

noUnsafeAwaitIgnoreCalls.description: Exact source call paths that noUnsafeAwait should ignore, such as startServer or fastify.after.

noUnsafeAwaitMode.description: Controls where noUnsafeAwait applies. resultar-context checks Resultar async contexts and safeTry bodies; all also reports framework and bootstrap awaits.

noUnknownResultError.description: Discourage unknown or any in Resultar error channels; prefer a concrete error type or typed catch mapper.

noUselessRecovery.description: Flag recovery calls on Result<T, never> and ResultAsync<T, never>.

preferAndThen.description: Prefer andThen or asyncAndThen when map returns a Resultar value.

preferCatchReason.description: Prefer catchReason or catchReasons when catchTag manually inspects a nested reason tag.

preferFirstSuccessOf.description: Prefer Result.firstSuccessOf or ResultAsync.firstSuccessOf for independent orElse fallbacks.

preferMap.description: Prefer map when andThen only wraps the callback value in Ok.

preferMapErr.description: Prefer mapErr when orElse only returns another Err.

preferResultForEach.description: Prefer Result.forEach or ResultAsync.forEach over combine applied to an intermediate map result list.

preferTaggedError.description: Prefer createTaggedError over plain Error subclasses, err(new Error(...)), or throw new Error(...).

taggedErrorNameMatch.description: Require createTaggedError({ name }) to match the class name.

typedCatchMapper.description: Require catch conversion helpers to map caught values to typed errors.

unsafeResultTypeAssertion.description: Prevent assertions that narrow Resultar error channels.

yieldStarInSafeTry.description: Require yield* for Resultar values inside safeTry.

yieldStarInResultTaskGen.description: Require yield* inside ResultTask.gen because plain yield is not a supported task or service composition.
